jobs.occupation: Project Manager Plant Development & Industrial Construction (d/f/m) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

Project Manager Plant Development & Industrial Construction (d/f/m)

To support our Plant Development & Cross-Project Management team, Airbus Aerostructures GmbH is seeking two Project Managers for Construction & Infrastructure (d/f/m) to be based in Hamburg.

We are driving production stability: from complex construction projects to strategic risk management, you will help secure the ramp-up of our successful Single Aisle, A350, and A330 programs. At the same time, you will act as a central point of contact for our customer, the Hamburg plant, and the plant strategy planning team.

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits For You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities

- Lead construction and infrastructure projects as well as a portfolio of critical ramp-up initiatives for plant Hamburg.
- Independently calculate CAPEX applications for new equipment and machinery, directly coordinating technical specifications with key stakeholders.
- Act as a central link in multifunctional teams to ensure that resources and hall infrastructure are fully operational for production.
- Monitor end-to-end performance through KPI-based governance and proactively deliver data-driven analyses to management.
- Develop comprehensive decision papers and continuously identify risks to ensure production stability in partnership with Finance and Facility Management.

Desired Skills And Qualifications

- Academic Background: University degree in Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
- Professional Expertise & Methodology: Proven track record in managing strategic construction or ramp-up projects within an industrial environment—ideally in assembly - complemented by proficiency in agile methodologies, Change Management, Six Sigma, and essential digital tools (SAP, G-Suite).
- Leadership & Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multifunctional teams and complex networks without direct line authority, serving as an effective communicator and mediator to align diverse stakeholder perspectives.
- Analytical & Entrepreneurial Mindset: A structured, data-driven approach with a strong affinity for processes and figures, and the capacity to effectively manage multiple parallel projects.
- Flexibility & Integrity: Exceptional adaptability in a dynamic, international environment, combined with a deep sense of responsibility regarding compliance and risk mitigation.
- Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in German and English, with the confidence to engage effectively from the shop floor to senior leadership.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Executive Director (Nachhaltigkeitsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
- 
The Climate Service Center Germany (GERICS), a scientific organizational entity of the Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon, invites applications for the "Executive Director" of the Global Coordination Hub for Future Earth, starting as soon as possible. The position is limited to 5 years and the place of employment is Hamburg.

Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. In principle, the full time position (39 h/week) is also sharable.

GERICS develops science-based prototype products and services in support to government, administration and business in their efforts to adapt to climate change. It builds up a national and international network structure in order to integrate existing competences and knowledge, and to link various actors within the complex area of climate change.

The Global Coordination Hub is jointly hosted by GERICS and the Julie Ann Wrigley Global Futures Laboratory at Arizona State University (ASU) as part of a shared hosting cooperation agreement - and is seeking an Executive Director to lead the coordination of Future Earth's globally distributed Secretariat (currently consisting of nine Global Hubs).

Future Earth is a global network advancing research to support transformations toward global sustainability. Its vision is a sustainable and equitable world for all, where societal decisions are informed by openly accessible and shared knowledge.

Your tasks

- lead the strategic and scientific development of the Future Earth network overseen by the Governing Council, the decision-making body of Future Earth
- lead and develop the Global Coordination Hub at GERICS/Hereon and GFL/ASU
- coordinate the globally distributed Secretariat of Future Earth (9 Global hubs in different parts of the world) and operationally lead the Global Coordination Hub
- coordinate collaboration with Global Research Networks and National/Regional Entities in alignment with Future Earth's mission
- represent the Future Earth Network at external engagements
- engage with custodian organisations, partner organisations, funders and stakeholders
- support the Future Earth governing bodies
- ensure operations are aligned with Future Earth principles: inclusiveness, diversity, sustainability, transparency and impartiality
- lead resource mobilization to ensure the long-term financial sustainability of Future Earth
- oversee preparation of the Secretariat's annual budget located at GERICS/Hereon

Your profile

- PhD in an area of sustainability science, Earth system science, science policy, or a closely related field
- strong international scientific credibility in sustainability science or a related domain
- proven senior leadership experience in complex, international and multi-stakeholder organisations or networks
- experience working with governance bodies, including preparation of materials and implementation of decisions
- experience coordinating teams across multiple geographies, cultures and time zones
- demonstrated experience in partnership development across research, policy and societal actors
- proven experience in resource mobilization and fundraising
- experience overseeing financial planning, budgeting or financial reporting processes
- excellent communication and representation skills in international contexts
- high level of interpersonal skills and ability to work across disciplines, sectors, cultures and geographies
- fluency in English

Informal enquiries can be directed to Dr. Sebastian Sonntag (sebastian.sonntag@hereon.de).
We offer you

- a unique opportunity to lead the coordination of a global research network at the forefront of sustainability science
- an exciting and varied job in a research centre with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations
- a well-connected research campus (public transport) and best networking opportunities, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket if certain conditions are met (job ticket)
- individual opportunities for further training
- social benefits according to the collective agreement of the public service and remuneration up to pay group 14 according to TV EntgO Bund
- an excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment
- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day
- very good compatibility private and professional life; offers of mobile and flexible work
- free assistance program for employees (EAP)
- corporate benefits
- office location in the heart of the city of Hamburg in the historic Chilehaus

Severely disabled persons and those equaling severely disabled persons who are equally suitable for the position will be considered preferentially within the framework of legal requirements.

Interested?
We are looking forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Technician (m/f/d) for Laboratory Infrastructure (Anlagenmechaniker/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 84 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.

The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD). is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.

The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).

The Department for Nanoscale Quantum Materials

is seeking a

Technician (m/f/d) for Laboratory Infrastructure

Your position

We are looking for a hands-on, versatile technician who keeps our laboratories running. You will be the go-to person for the technical infrastructure and day-to-day operations of our experiments. This role complements our engineering and scientific staff, with a focus on practical work, maintenance, and operational readiness.  Your tasks will include:

· **Infrastructure Maintenance:** Independent maintenance, servicing, and monitoring of the laboratory’s technical systems (including vacuum pumps and vacuum systems, gas supply installations, and cryogenic equipment). Implementation of, and adherence to, associated laboratory safety protocols and standards

· **Installations:** Installation and modification of laboratory infrastructure, such as connecting and exchanging pressurized gas cylinders, and routing gas, cooling water, and vacuum lines.

· **Mechanical Assembly:** Planning and executing mechanical work, including the assembly, installation, and relocation of scientific equipment, as well as constructing experimental support frames and enclosures (e.g., using aluminum extrusion profiles). Performing electromechanical tasks such as soldering, crimping, and custom cable/connector assembly.

· **Coordination:** Coordinating deliveries, storage, and workshop logistics; liaising with external service technicians, facility management, and contractors.

· **General Lab Support:** Providing proactive, hands-on assistance for daily laboratory operations as an integral part of the research team.

Your qualification

· **Education:** Completed vocational training (Berufsausbildung) in a relevant technical trade, such as Electronics Technician (Elektroniker/in), Mechatronics Technician (Mechatroniker/in), Precision Mechanic (Feinmechaniker/in), Plant/HVAC Mechanic (Anlagenmechaniker/in), Refrigeration Technician (Mechatroniker/in für Kältetechnik), Physics Laboratory Assistant (Physiklaborant/in), or equivalent skills acquired through substantial professional experience.

· **Work Style:** A strong hands-on mentality, practical problem-solving skills, and genuine enjoyment of a broad, varied range of technical tasks within an active experimental environment. A careful, safety-conscious, and independent approach to work.

· **Language Skills:** A solid command of German (essential for liaising with external contractors and local technical infrastructure) combined with functional, conversational English to communicate within our international research team (or a strong willingness to improve existing English skills).

· **Teamwork:** Team spirit and the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, evolving research environment.

Desirable, but not required:

· Practical experience with vacuum technology, cryogenics, or the handling of pressurized and liquefied gases.

· Knowledge of low-voltage electrical installations, measurement electronics, or sensor cabling.

Our offer

We offer an innovative environment, which will give you the opportunity to develop your own ideas at the forefront of ultrafast science embedded in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL). We offer a position according to the German public pay scale (TVöD). The position is initially limited to two years, with possibility of extended employment. Collaborations with experimental groups in Hamburg and other locations are planned.

The Max Planck Society and our group specifically strive for gender and diversity equality. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and we are committed to improve gender balance. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.

Your application

**To apply, please complete the online application form** (https://jobs.b-ite.com/en/jobposting/a096b515fda4e11057a4381b57cdae5663b754100/apply)

Applications should include a letter of motivation and a curriculum vitae. Please submit your application in English only. The call for this position will close on 13.09.2026.

For further information please contact Dr. Lars Tiemann

email: lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de)

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant (m/f/d) (Office-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.

The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.

The MPSD currently consists of three scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).

For our department "nanoscale quantum materials" we are looking for an

Administrative Assistant (m/f/d)

Your position

- You will support the department in all organizational matters related to the day-to-day business and ensure that administrative operations run smoothly. Your responsibilities will include, among others - Serve as the central point of contact and liaison between the two directors and the scientific and administrative units of the institute
- General administration and assistance: managing correspondence, maintaining databases and records, and working closely with the institute's central administration
- Travel management for the directors and department staff, including support for visiting scientists and guests (invitations, visa matters, accommodation, Processing reimbursements in accordance with the German Federal Travel Expenses Act (Bundesreisekostengesetz))
- Organization, coordination, preparation, and follow-up of internal and external meetings, seminars, conferences, and events
- Onboarding and offboarding of employees in collaboration with the HR department
- Coordination and tracking of purchase orders in cooperation with the procurement department
- Although this is primarily an administrative position, the role offers much more than routine tasks: You will work in an inspiring research environment at the intersection of science, organization, and international exchange. jobs.occupation: F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our engineering activities, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m)

In this role, you will contribute to the structural integrity and safety of Airbus aircraft. As a key member of our Structural Analysis Community, you will handle calculations and support our digital transformation initiatives, collaborating closely with design, production and subcontracting partners.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Create analysis models, static and/or F&DT calculations, reports and studies for Airbus aircraft structures (A350XWB and A320 Family)
- Prepare the definition of analysis methods and specifications
- Check internally and externally created analysis data and documentation
- Check relevant input to design for the creation of drawings for manufacturing and support other functions (i.e.: production, customer support) as needed
- Technically guide the sub-contracting companies providing structure analysis work
- Apply airworthiness regulations and relevant design principles
- Define and interpret structural tests for certification
- Monitor project performance
- Support the digital transformation within the structural analysis department by implementing automation, simplifying tools, and redesigning processes.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- University degree in the engineering / aerospace field or similar qualification acquired in another way
- Experience in the development of aircraft structures (metal & composite) would be a plus
- Knowledge in numerical calculations
- Proficiency in analytical calculation methods (e.g.ISAMI, HSB, Niu, Bruhn)
- Solid knowledge in programming languages (e.g.: Python) and data analytics
- Motivation to work autonomously, take responsibilities and foster communication with all stakeholders
- Open and curious mindset proactively searching for continuous self-development
- English fluency in written and spoken form

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
